rule: The hourly trigger is only a watchdog. A recent running heartbeat means another execution is alive and this run must not mutate the repository. A stale or released lease may be recovered. The active execution does not stop because an hourly boundary or time budget was reached; it continues until verified AGI or the platform/process actually ends, while persisting heartbeats and exact continuation state. Derived hourly boundaries are retained for audit but are not enforced as stop conditions in watchdog mode.
